blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.10
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.10

blocks.text: अविवेको मायासौषुप्तम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] अविवेको मायासौषुप्तम्

blocks.text: Aviveko māyāsauṣuptam.
blocks.directed: Aviveko māyāsauṣuptam.

blocks.text: Non-discernment is the deep sleep associated with Māyā.
blocks.directed: Non-discernment is the deep sleep associated with Māyā.

blocks.text: Deep Sleep: No Thoughts, Still Not Enlightened.
blocks.directed: Deep Sleep: No Thoughts, Still Not Enlightened.

blocks.text: Now we’ve reached the third condition.
blocks.directed: Now we’ve reached the third condition.

blocks.text: No ordinary waking perception.
blocks.directed: No ordinary waking perception.

blocks.text: No elaborate dream imagery.
blocks.directed: No elaborate dream imagery.

blocks.text: No conceptual soap opera.
blocks.directed: No conceptual soap opera.

blocks.text: Just profound non-discernment.
blocks.directed: Just profound non-discernment.

blocks.text: You might be tempted to conclude:
blocks.directed: [short pause] You might be tempted to conclude:

blocks.text: “Excellent. No thoughts, no suffering, no separation. Therefore deep sleep is enlightenment.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Excellent. No thoughts, no suffering, no separation. Therefore deep sleep is enlightenment.”

blocks.text: Unfortunately, Vasugupta is not having it.
blocks.directed: Unfortunately, Vasugupta is not having it.

blocks.text: Because the absence of differentiated experience is not automatically the recognition of your true nature.
blocks.directed: Because the absence of differentiated experience is not automatically the recognition of your true nature.

blocks.text: A person emerging from dreamless sleep ordinarily hasn’t acquired the knowledge:
blocks.directed: [short pause] A person emerging from dreamless sleep ordinarily hasn’t acquired the knowledge:

blocks.text: “I am universal consciousness, intrinsically free, the source of manifestation.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am universal consciousness, intrinsically free, the source of manifestation.”

blocks.text: They’ve acquired the knowledge:
blocks.directed: [short pause] They’ve acquired the knowledge:

blocks.text: “Where’s my phone?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Where’s my phone?”

blocks.text: The subtle distinction is between the absence of manifest differentiation and the positive recognition of nondual awareness.
blocks.directed: The subtle distinction is between the absence of manifest differentiation and the positive recognition of nondual awareness.

blocks.text: One is a condition in which distinctions are unmanifest.
blocks.directed: One is a condition in which distinctions are unmanifest.

blocks.text: The other is recognition of the conscious reality underlying all distinctions, whether they are manifest or not.
blocks.directed: The other is recognition of the conscious reality underlying all distinctions, whether they are manifest or not.

blocks.text: And Māyā remains relevant because non-discernment does not itself undo the structures of limitation.
blocks.directed: And Māyā remains relevant because non-discernment does not itself undo the structures of limitation.

blocks.text: This is why Trika refuses to equate enlightenment with unconsciousness, blankness, or simply suppressing thought.
blocks.directed: This is why Trika refuses to equate enlightenment with unconsciousness, blankness, or simply suppressing thought.

blocks.text: You cannot become Śiva by knocking yourself unconscious.
blocks.directed: You cannot become Śiva by knocking yourself unconscious.

blocks.text: Terrible news for anyone hoping to attain liberation through an exceptionally long afternoon nap.
blocks.directed: Terrible news for anyone hoping to attain liberation through an exceptionally long afternoon nap.
